messages.content: 你是 lecture 互动组件(sim.widget)的设计规划器。先想清楚结构再写码，本步**不写 HTML**，只输出一个结构化契约 JSON 对象：不要代码围栏、不要解释。

You are the design-planning step for an interactive UI widget generator. You do NOT write final HTML/CSS/JS here. You produce a STRUCTURAL CONTRACT as JSON — a precise blueprint that the next step implements verbatim. The contract pins down the four things that most often go wrong (layout, state, interaction, aesthetic direction) while leaving drawing details to the implementer.

Current request:
所在讲义课题：「数据结构-AVL」。本互动组件的教学意图：模拟插入后回溯调整过程
本块角色: practice。
页级共享契约（所有同页 block 必须协同，不得各讲各的）:
{"page": {"kind": "content", "eyebrow": "直观理解", "headline": "插入后回溯：从插入点向上调整", "lead": "插入新节点后，从插入点向上回溯，更新平衡因子，遇到不平衡则旋转。"}, "brief": {"objective": "学生能通过操作理解插入后从插入点向上回溯更新平衡因子并旋转", "learningAction": "manipulate", "requiredEvidence": "学生拖拽节点完成插入并观察平衡因子更新和旋转触发", "keyClaim": "插入后从插入点向上回溯，更新平衡因子，遇到不平衡则旋转", "misconception": "只需要在插入点旋转", "visualTask": "树节点可拖拽改变位置，系统自动计算平衡因子并提示旋转", "evidencePolicy": "derived"}, "siblingPlan": [{"id": "b1_ins", "type": "sim", "role": "practice", "intent": "模拟插入后回溯调整过程", "size": "xl"}]}
证据纪律：没有参考素材时，不得虚构论文年份、人物原话、百分比或精确行业数字；数值只能是可复算推导，或在画面中明确标为示意/合成数据。视觉必须真实编码 visualTask 所述关系。。

Suggested widget type:
interactive

Relevant recent conversation:


Think about what makes this a GOOD demonstration — not a static picture. For conceptual/technical topics (algorithms, architectures, physical systems, math), the user wants to manipulate something and SEE the consequence. A static labelled diagram with a click-to-show-text panel is a failure mode — avoid it.

CLARITY BEATS RICHNESS. The single most important thing is that the core concept reads crisply and unambiguously. A clean diagram that shows ONE idea sharply is far better than a busy widget with many controls where the main visual is muddy. Do NOT add extra controls, modes, or parameters (extra kernels, free-form editing, multiple toggles) if they make the central visualization harder to read. When in doubt, cut.

Rendering medium — choose deliberately, state it in the contract:
- Geometric / structural concepts (boundaries, lines, vectors, regions, graphs, flows, hierarchies) → DECLARATIVE SVG with named elements (`<line>`, `<path>`, `<circle>`). Crisp vector strokes. Compute lines/curves ANALYTICALLY and set element coordinates — NEVER draw a boundary by sampling a pixel grid and dotting cells; that looks blurry and noisy.
- Use `<canvas>` ONLY for genuinely pixel/particle-heavy content: many moving particles, continuous fields, fluid/heat simulation, dense per-pixel shading. If the core visual is lines and shapes, canvas is the wrong tool.
- Note: canvas does NOT reliably resolve `var(--color-*)` for fillStyle/strokeStyle — another reason to prefer SVG for anything color-coded.

Aesthetic direction — pick ONE deliberately (the implementation step receives the full specs; this is the menu):
- lab-dark: instrument: tick rulers, mono readouts, one live trace — re-skins to the app theme — physics/chem/algorithm sims, particles, waves
- paper-editorial: warm paper, serif display, terracotta/moss — poetry, literature, history, language, philosophy
- studio-pop: white + bold geometric color blocks, hard offset shadows — art, design, music, playful or kid-facing topics
- terminal-data: mono tabular numerals, green/red deltas, sparklines — finance, metrics, performance dashboards
- soft-organic: cream + sage/clay blob shapes, breathing motion — biology, nature, health, food, emotions
- blueprint: pale grid + indigo ink, dashed construction lines — mechanics, architecture, how-things-work cutaways
- ink-wash: raw paper + layered ink ridgelines, seal-red accent — classical Chinese subjects: poetry, landscape, calligraphy, tea
- host-calm: app-native quiet, host CSS variables — data records, forms, business UI mockups
Match the SUBJECT's mood, not habit. Variety is a goal: widgets on different topics must not share a direction. If the user names a style ("cyberpunk", "watercolor"), answer custom:<name> and define the palette yourself.

Design rules the contract MUST respect:
- Width is fluid (host-driven, unknown). Layout uses 100% / 1fr / minmax(0,1fr) — never fixed pixel widths on regions. Height grows with content.
- NO in-widget headline: the chat message already introduces the widget, so the skeleton must not contain a title block that restates the request (and never a title + explainer subtitle). Content titles (a poem's name, a "FIG. 1" caption) are allowed — small and in-style. If a label row exists, controls form their own full-width wrap row below it, never side-by-side with it.
- Status/phase indicators live ON the stage (corner label, progress dots) — never boxed as a metric card. Metric card rows only for 3+ genuinely comparable, continuously-changing numbers; otherwise one primary readout + a quiet inline row.
- The main visualization is the DOMINANT element: full content width by default (stage+readout-row), or at least 60% of it in a split. Its on-screen area must exceed all side panels combined. A small stage next to a tall stack of control/data cards is a known failure — controls go in a wrap row ABOVE the stage, readouts in a row BELOW it.
- balanced-split is allowed ONLY when the sidebar holds at most 2 short cards whose combined height stays under the stage height. 3+ sidebar cards = wrong pattern; switch to stage+readout-row. The skeleton must state the stage's aspect ratio and require `align-items: start` on the container.
- No region scrolls internally. Ranked/score lists cap at the top 6-8 entries shown in full.
- At least one control must produce a VISIBLE change in the main visualization.
- The initial render is non-empty and meaningful — never "click to start".
- There is ONE update entry point: every state change calls a single update() that re-derives the view from current state. For SVG this means updating the named elements' attributes; for canvas it means a redraw. Either way, no scattered ad-hoc mutations spread across handlers.

Return ONE JSON object only — no prose, no markdown fences. Schema:

{
  "core_insight": "<one sentence — what the user should understand after using this>",
  "render_medium": "svg | canvas",
  "render_medium_reason": "<short — why this medium fits the core visual>",
  "aesthetic_direction": "<lab-dark | paper-editorial | studio-pop | terminal-data | soft-organic | blueprint | ink-wash | host-calm | custom:<short-name>>",
  "direction_reason": "<one short clause — why this direction fits this subject>",
  "palette": ["<surface hex>", "<ink hex>", "<accent1 hex>", "<accent2 hex, optional>"],
  "signature_detail": "<ONE memorable visual idea, e.g. 'glowing bob with fading motion trail', 'oversized serif drop cap', 'dashed dimension arrows with end ticks'>",
  "layout_pattern": "<stage+readout-row | balanced-split | stepper | bento | editorial-column — simulations and anything with a main viz default to stage+readout-row (FULL-WIDTH stage); pick balanced-split ONLY if the sidebar is at most 2 short cards whose combined height stays under the stage height>",
  "layout_skeleton": "<region tree implementing layout_pattern, top-to-bottom, with fluid sizing AND column balance, e.g. 'title row (100%) / controls wrap row (100%) / stage canvas 16:9 (100%) / readout row (3x 1fr)'>",
  "state_model": [
    {"name": "<jsVarName>", "type": "int|float|bool|string|array", "range_or_values": "<e.g. 0..7, true/false, ['我','爱','你']>", "initial": "<concrete initial value>"}
  ],
  "interactions": [
    {"trigger": "<element + event, e.g. 'range#heads input'>", "effect": "<which state changes and what updates visually>"}
  ],
  "render_contract": "<one sentence: what update() re-derives from state, and (for SVG) which named elements it sets, or (for canvas) what it redraws>",
  "initial_paint": "<what is on screen at first render, with concrete values from state_model initials. Must be MID-ACTION: the system one step in (first iteration applied, simulation a moment after launch) — never a zeroed dashboard or an empty stage waiting for a click>"
}

Keep every string tight and concrete. Prefer "range#k (1..8) -> recompute neighbors, recolor decision regions" over "interactive slider". The state_model names you choose ARE the variable names the implementer will use.

---

LectureDoc host extension（优先于上面的通用 schema）：返回同一个 JSON 对象，但必须额外加入：
{
  "visible_encodings": [{"quantity":"标题/objective 声称解释的量","mark":"轴/曲线/点/箭头/文本","where":"首帧位置或图例"}],
  "comparison_states": ["若目标要求比较，逐项列出首帧必须同时可见的状态；否则空数组"],
  "interaction_loop": {"action":"学习者的具体操作","model_update":"操作如何改变 state_model","visible_change":"哪一个视觉编码立即变化","history":"如何保留前态/当前态或 before→after 映射","reset":"如何确定性回到同一初态"},
  "math_model": {"formula":"主公式；非数学题写 none","screen_mapping":"数学坐标到屏幕坐标，尤其 y 轴符号","invariants":["必须恒真的关系"]},
  "verification_cases": [{"input":"具体状态/参数","expected":"可复算结果或符号关系"}]
}
并把通用字段 render_contract 同值复制为 update。若 objective/intent 含“比较”，comparison_states 不得为空，
initial_paint 必须同时出现全部状态；不得靠学生拖动滑块后脑补对照。数学题的 screen_mapping、invariants、
verification_cases 均不得为空。所有题型的 interaction_loop 五项和 verification_cases 都不得为空；用例至少覆盖
首帧中间态、一次有效转移、复位，数值控件再覆盖最小/最大边界。声明的整个范围必须保持
有限、非空且可读。发散系统应缩短到有教学意义的范围，不能让极端值把主图压成一条线。只输出完整 JSON 对象。
契约不合格：契约解析失败。补齐字段后只输出完整 JSON 对象。

{
  "core_insight": "插入新节点后，从插入点向上回溯，更新平衡因子，遇到不平衡则旋转，使树重新平衡。",
  "render_medium": "svg",
  "render_medium_reason": "树结构由节点和边组成，需要精确控制节点位置、平衡因子标签和旋转箭头，SVG提供清晰的矢量渲染。",
  "aesthetic_direction": "blueprint",
  "direction_reason": "蓝图风格适合展示算法中的旋转操作，如同机械构造，网格和虚线辅助线增强理解。",
  "palette": ["#f0f4f8", "#1e3a5f", "#d62828", "#2a9d8f"],
  "signature_detail": "旋转时节点周围出现虚线圆弧箭头，表示旋转方向。",
  "layout_pattern": "stage+readout-row",
  "layout_skeleton": "controls wrap row (100%) / stage svg (100%, min-height: 400px) / readout row (3x 1fr)",
  "state_model": [
    {"name": "treeData", "type": "array", "range_or_values": "节点对象数组，每个节点有id, value, left, right, height, bf", "initial": [{"id":1,"value":30,"left":2,"right":3,"height":2,"bf":0},{"id":2,"value":20,"left":4,"right":null,"height":2,"bf":2},{"id":3,"value":40,"left":null,"right":null,"height":0,"bf":0},{"id":4,"value":10,"left":5,"right":null,"height":1,"bf":1},{"id":5,"value":5,"left":null,"right":null,"height":0,"bf":0}]},
    {"name": "insertValue", "type": "int", "range_or_values": "1..100", "initial": 5},
    {"name": "stepIndex", "type": "int", "range_or_values": "0..10", "initial": 0},
    {"name": "phase", "type": "string", "range_or_values": "['insert','backtrack','rotate','done']", "initial": "backtrack"},
    {"name": "highlightNodeId", "type": "int", "range_or_values": "节点id", "initial": 2},
    {"name": "rotationType", "type": "string", "range_or_values": "['none','LL','RR','LR','RL']", "initial": "LL"}
  ],
  "interactions": [
    {"trigger": "button#reset click", "effect": "重置treeData到初始平衡树（无插入节点），insertValue=5，stepIndex=0，phase='insert'，highlightNodeId=null，rotationType='none'"},
    {"trigger": "input#insertValue change", "effect": "更新insertValue为输入值"},
    {"trigger": "button#insert click", "effect": "将insertValue插入到当前treeData（如果phase不是'insert'则先重置），更新treeData，设置phase='backtrack'，stepIndex=0，highlightNodeId为插入点的父节点，rotationType根据不平衡类型设置"},
    {"trigger": "button#next click", "effect": "根据当前phase和stepIndex执行下一步：如果phase='backtrack'，则更新下一个祖先的平衡因子，如果发现不平衡则设置rotationType并进入'rotate'；如果phase='rotate'，则执行旋转更新treeData，设置phase='done'；如果phase='done'，则无变化。stepIndex增加。"},
    {"trigger": "button#prev click", "effect": "如果stepIndex>0，则stepIndex减1，恢复上一步的treeData快照，相应更新phase、highlightNodeId、rotationType"}
  ],
  "render_contract": "update()从state_model重新绘制树：根据treeData绘制节点圆圈、节点值、边、平衡因子标签、高度标签；根据highlightNodeId高亮节点（红色边框）；根据rotationType绘制旋转箭头（虚线圆弧）；根据phase显示阶段标签。",
  "update": "update()从state_model重新绘制树：根据treeData绘制节点圆圈、节点值、边、平衡因子标签、高度标签；根据highlightNodeId高亮节点（红色边框）；根据rotationType绘制旋转箭头（虚线圆弧）；根据phase显示阶段标签。",
  "initial_paint": "显示一个AVL树，包含节点30、20、40、10、5，节点20高亮（红色边框），旁边显示bf=2，节点10显示bf=1，其他节点bf=0；节点下方显示高度；树上方显示阶段标签“回溯中”；右侧显示旋转类型“LL旋转”；底部有控制按钮（重置、插入值输入、插入按钮、下一步按钮、上一步按钮），下一步按钮可用。",
  "visible_encodings": [
    {"quantity": "节点值", "mark": "文本", "where": "节点圆圈内"},
    {"quantity": "平衡因子", "mark": "文本（bf=...）", "where": "节点右侧或上方"},
    {"quantity": "高度", "mark": "文本（h=...）", "where": "节点下方"},
    {"quantity": "回溯路径", "mark": "高亮边框或颜色", "where": "当前节点"},
    {"quantity": "旋转类型", "mark": "箭头或标签", "where": "旋转轴附近"}
  ],
  "comparison_states": [],
  "interaction_loop": {
    "action": "学习者点击“下一步”按钮",
    "model_update": "stepIndex增加，根据当前phase更新treeData（更新平衡因子或执行旋转），更新highlightNodeId和rotationType",
    "visible_change": "树结构变化（旋转后节点位置变化），平衡因子数字变化，高亮节点移动，旋转箭头出现或消失",
    "history": "使用步骤数组存储每一步的treeData快照，用户可通过“上一步”按钮回退",
    "reset": "点击“重置”按钮，回到初始平衡树（无插入），phase='insert'，stepIndex=0，highlightNodeId=null，rotationType='none'"
  },
  "math_model": {
    "formula": "bf = height(left) - height(right); 旋转规则：LL右旋，RR左旋，LR左右旋，RL右左旋",
    "screen_mapping": "树节点坐标：根节点在顶部居中，子节点在下方左右，y轴向下，x轴根据层数偏移。数学坐标到屏幕坐标：y_screen = y_math + offset, x_screen = x_math + offset",
    "invariants": ["每个节点的高度等于max(左子树高度,右子树高度)+1", "旋转后子树高度恢复", "平衡树中每个节点平衡因子绝对值不超过1"]
  },
  "verification_cases": [
    {"input": "初始状态（treeData包含5,10,20,30,40，phase='backtrack'，highlightNodeId=2，rotationType='LL'）", "expected": "节点20高亮，bf=2，显示LL旋转标签，阶段显示“回溯中”"},
    {"input": "点击下一步（从初始状态）", "expected": "执行LL旋转，树变为以20为根，10左子，30右子，5在10左，40在30右，所有节点bf为0或±1，高亮消失，阶段变为“完成”"},
    {"input": "点击重置", "expected": "树变为30,20,40,10（无5），phase='insert'，highlightNodeId=null，rotationType='none'"}
  ]
}
